# ScriptItem

*Common*

Item type (such as `minecraft:diamond`) of an item stack, from [`getItem()`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack#getitem).

## Methods

### getItemStack {#getitemstack}

::: member

```js
var stack = c.getPlayer().getMainItem().getItem().getItemStack();
```

**Returns** `ItemStack` — new Minecraft stack of one item of this kind, for Java code; use `scram.item(id)` in scripts

:::

### getMinecraftItem {#getminecraftitem}

::: member

**Returns** `Item` — the Minecraft item, for Java code

:::

### getId {#getid}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — item ID, like `"minecraft:diamond_hoe"`

:::

### isSame {#issame}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `item` | [`ScriptItem`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItem) | other item, or null |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether both are the same item

:::
